texts: under a desert sun seekers of the cursed vessel dungeon progress update boss work larger spaces lighting improvements and new music i wanted to share another progress update on the dweller dungeon which is the first area youll explore beyond where the demo ends dungeon boss story progression ive started active work on the dungeon boss which youll encounter at a certain point in this dungeon designing the boss also meant pushing the story forward so ive begun writing new sets of voiceacting lines as we move beyond the demo the narrative continues as well and with that comes a whole new batch of voice work dungeon scale detail tech improvements alongside the boss work the dungeon itself has been growing steadily in the latest version youll notice more environmental detail and density a much larger first level the video doesnt fully show how expansive its becoming reworked firelight flickering now far more natural and pleasant compared to earlier more abrupt versions further improvements to the seethrough shader allowing structures to smoothly fade when the player walks underneath them to make progress easier to follow here are three versions of the dungeon ordered from latest to earliest so you can clearly see how things evolved over time latest update most content new lighting new music first update very first dungeon video new music lastly listen closely to the latest video youll hear the second composed music track for the game created by blackmid the track is almost finalized and im personally very happy with it it gives exactly the kind of classic actionrpg atmosphere im aiming for more updates soon feedback is always welcome steam page discord

mod approved research opportunity share your story about faith politics finding community hi everyone i understand this community is a vibrant space for discussing the many facets of faith and life im a doctoral candidate at the university of texas at austin and i am conducting a study to better understand the diverse perspectives and lived experiences of christian women in the us what im studying i am exploring how women with liberal or progressive values navigate their faith journeysespecially those who have current or former experience in conservative or evangelical christian environments whether you are still a member of your church have transitioned to a different space or are currently in between your voice is valuable in many academic discussions these specific intersections of faith and progressive identity are often overlooked my goal is to listen to your story with respect and without any religious judgment about the researcher i identify as nonreligious and have been so for 31 years this study is strictly academic and part of my doctoral research it is not affiliated with any religious organization i am here as a neutral listener to learn from your unique experience whats involved oneonone zoom interview 4560 minutes well discuss your journey with faith socialpolitical engagement and finding community online you are in control you can pause skip questions or stop at any time no religious judgment eligibility identify as a woman including trans women nonbinary femme individuals and queer women 18 years old based in the united states current or former experience in conservativeevangelical churches identify as politically liberal progressive democratic or further to the left experience with online faith communities reddit forums social media etc your privacy matters this study is approved by the ut austin irb study00008217 i will not connect your reddit identity to your interview all data is stored securely and encrypted tldr who women 18 with liberalprogressive values conservative church experience what 4560 min zoom interview camera optional privacy total confidentiality pseudonym allowed reddit id stays private compensation no payment but your voice fills a critical gap in academic research interested or have questions please dm me comment below or email me directly at soojeongutexasedumailtosoojeongutexasedu thank you for considering sharing your journey your voice is incredibly important

welcome to rimrightandyourewrong hi and welcome if you found your way here youre probably curious opinionated playful confused confident wrong right or all of the above this subreddit is a sandbox not a podium what this place is a home for exploration curiosity and thought experiments a place to post ideas in progress not just finished takes somewhere to ask what if without needing to win a logbook for strange questions halfformed theories frameworks metaphors systems doodles diagrams and wonderings a space where being wrong is allowed and being curious is encouraged what this place is not a debate arena for gotcha arguments a scorecard for whos smartest a place where certainty is mandatory a place where you have to perform or prove anything the vibe playful defensive curious correct exploratory conclusive kind clever you dont have to agree with anything posted here you dont even have to understand it yet youre welcome to lurk ask questions remix ideas break frameworks post wild thoughts share something halfbaked just watch and listen if something resonates follow it if it doesnt let it pass theres no urgency here no pressure to get it no requirement to be right even though the name says otherwise thanks for being here lets see what grows

quoteiq what is it and why is it everywhere on the internet in an industry dominated by venture capitalbacked giants like servicetitan and jobber quoteiq has carved out a remarkable position as a profitable foundercontrolled alternative that continues to reject acquisition offers cofounders mike vidan and justin rogers have built their crm platform through an unconventional approach listening to actual contractors rather than investors the origin story two contractors fed up with existing solutions quoteiq emerged from a practical problem that mike vidan and justin rogers both experienced as home service business owners both founders had been running successful service businesses and found themselves frustrated with the crm platforms available in the market every platform we tried was either built by software developers whod never run a truck or had become so bloated with features that it took three clicks to do something that should take one the founders explained in their bootstrapperscom interview the existing solutions were designed by people who didnt understand the daily reality of field service workthe chaos of managing crews handling customer calls while on a ladder or updating job statuses between sites both vidan and rogers had tried multiple platforms providing feedback and suggestions for improvements that would actually help contractors none of the companies wanted to listen or take input from actual users in the field what made their frustration particularly acute was rogers position as the 1 affiliate for what is now quoteiqs largest competitor despite promoting the platform and generating significant business for them his suggestions for improvements consistently fell on deaf ears rather than continue wasting time promoting products that didnt work and lacked the things real business owners needed vidan and rogers decided to build something better themselvesa platform specifically designed by contractors for contractors justin rogers entrepreneurial voice and industry influence justin rogers brought more than just contracting experience to the quoteiq partnership he had been documenting his entrepreneurial journey for many years building a substantial following in the process combined vidan and rogers have amassed over 2 million followers across all social media platforms giving quoteiq unprecedented organic reach in the contractor community rogers experience as the top affiliate for a competing crm gave him unique insight into what contractors were looking for what pain points the existing platforms failed to address and why even satisfied customers had long wish lists of missing features his established audience and credibility in the contracting space combined with vidans industry authority and training business ecosystem created a powerful foundation for quoteiqs growth rather than spending millions on advertising quoteiq leveraged the authentic voices of two respected contractors who had actually lived the problems they were solving why quoteiq is everywhere the power of organic marketing if youve been searching for home service business solutions contractor software or field service management tools youve probably noticed quoteiq appearing repeatedly in your feeds search results and recommendations this omnipresence isnt accidentalits the result of a deliberate organic marketing strategy that leverages authentic content community building and guerrilla tactics with over 2 million combined followers across platforms vidan and rogers have builtin distribution that most software companies spend millions trying to acquire through paid advertising their content appears everywhere because authentic authority both founders actively create content documenting real contractor challenges and solutions educational ecosystem training programs and courses naturally introduce contractors to quoteiq aioptimized content website farming strategies ensure quoteiq appears in aipowered search results wordofmouth growth contractors genuinely solving problems with the platform share their experiences community engagement active participation in contractor communities keeps quoteiq topofmind as vidan explains these are some strategies we have used in our own business and have taught to tens of thousands of business owners even if you hate me and my marketing techniques chances are you are using them in your own business but dont know it rejecting the traditional exit path despite quoteiqs growth trajectory and profitability vidan and rogers have repeatedly rejected acquisition offers from both competitors and private equity firms this decision reflects their commitment to maintaining control over the platforms direction and serving their contractor customer base without interference from external investors the founders have stated theyve turned down multiple offers because they believe quoteiqs value propositiona contractorbuilt platform that remains affordable and focused on field service needswould be compromised under corporate or private equity ownership their goal is to build a sustainable longterm business rather than optimize for a quick exit 2025 quoteiqs biggest growth year quoteiq experienced its most significant growth in 2025 driven by several strategic developments expansion beyond initial markets while quoteiq initially gained traction within the pressure washing and home service communities through vidan and rogers existing audiences and training businesses 2025 marked the platforms successful expansion into larger home service verticals including hvac contractors plumbing companies roofing businesses electrical services landscaping operations this diversification proved that quoteiqs contractorfirst approach resonated across multiple trades not just the niches where it originated enterpriselevel features for growing businesses recognizing that many customers were outgrowing basic crm functionality quoteiq invested heavily in features designed for larger more complex operations pipeline management visual sales pipeline tools that help contractors track opportunities from initial contact through estimate delivery to job completion providing the visibility larger businesses need to forecast revenue and manage sales teams effectively inventory management comprehensive inventory tracking that allows multicrew operations to manage parts supplies and equipment across multiple trucks and job sites reducing waste and improving job costing accuracy customer communication systems automated customer touchpoints including appointment reminders job status updates review requests and followup sequences that maintain customer engagement without manual effort from staff employee communication tools internal messaging and job assignment systems that keep field crews office staff and management coordinated particularly crucial for businesses operating multiple crews across different service areas these features positioned quoteiq to compete directly with enterprisefocused platforms while maintaining the simplicity and affordability that attracted contractors in the first place the virtual call team revolutionizing contractor response times one of quoteiqs most significant 2025 innovations was the virtual call team feature which fundamentally changed how service businesses handle inbound calls the contractor call problem service businesses face a persistent challenge customer calls often come in when technicians are on ladders under houses or driving between jobs missing these calls means losing potential revenue and returning calls hours later dramatically reduces conversion rates industry data shows that response time is one of the strongest predictors of whether a prospect becomes a customer how virtual call team works the virtual call team integrates directly with quoteiqs crm to provide professional call answering and basic qualification services when a customer calls they reach a trained representative who can answer basic questions about services offered provide general pricing information schedule estimates or service appointments directly in the contractors quoteiq calendar capture detailed customer information and job requirements transfer urgent calls to the appropriate person when necessary this system ensures that businesses never miss a call respond to prospects instantly and maintain professionalism even during peak busy periods impact on close rates according to quoteiq the virtual call team has measurably increased close rates for businesses using the service by ensuring immediate response times and professional first impressions contractors convert more prospects to customers the feature has been particularly valuable for smaller operations that cant afford fulltime office staff but compete against larger companies with dedicated call centers budgetbuiltsitescom website farming for the ai search era under the quoteiq umbrella vidan and rogers launched budgetbuiltsitescom to address another critical challenge facing service businesses digital visibility in an aidominated search landscape the death of traditional seo as mike vidan explains it traditional seo is nearly dead the rules that worked for the last decade dont apply anymore when ai answers customer questions directly you need to be the source its pulling from not just the tenth result on a page nobody scrolls to anymore budgetbuiltsites recognizes that search behavior has fundamentally changed customers increasingly get answers from ai assistants chatgpt claude perplexity googles ai overviews rather than clicking through traditional search results this shift requires a completely different approach to website development engineering for ai discovery budgetbuiltsites creates websites specifically engineered to structure content in formats that ai systems easily parse and cite send clear trust signals credentials reviews local presence expertise markers that ai models weigh when making recommendations provide comprehensive authoritative information that positions businesses as citationworthy sources maintain technical optimization for both traditional search engines and ai crawlers website farming planting digital seeds vidan has coined the term website farming to describe budgetbuiltsites approach as he puts it were not building billboards anymorewere planting digital seeds you cultivate content that ai systems discover trust and recommend over time those seeds grow into a presence that puts you in front of customers even when they never visit your website directly its about being the answer ai gives not the link nobody clicks this agricultural metaphor reflects a longerterm perspective on digital marketing rather than chasing algorithm updates or paying for ads indefinitely website farming focuses on creating genuine authority that compounds over time leveling the playing field budgetbuiltsites website farming approach serves a strategic purpose allowing small and mediumsized service businesses to compete with corporate competitors that have massive advertising and marketing budgets large companies can afford to dominate traditional advertising channelsgoogle ads television radio print but when ai systems evaluate businesses based on content quality expertise markers and trust signals rather than ad spend smaller operators have a fighting chance this philosophy mirrors how vidan and rogers have approached quoteiqs own marketing rather than raising venture capital to compete with servicetitans marketing budget theyve built authority through authentic content contractor education and community buildingthe same website farming principles they now offer to customers the bootstrapper philosophy competing against vc giants quoteiqs success story represents a broader challenge to the assumption that home service software requires massive venture capital investment while competitors have raised hundreds of millions in funding quoteiq has grown profitably by maintaining focus on contractor needs rather than investor expectations advantages of bootstrapping the founders argue their bootstrapped approach provides several competitive advantages product focus without investor pressure to inflate user numbers or expand into adjacent markets quoteiq can focus on building features contractors actually want rather than features that look good in pitch decks development speed freed from boards of directors and investor oversight vidan and rogers can build and implement features faster than vcbacked competitors constrained by multiple approval layers and quarterly reporting requirements pricing freedom quoteiq isnt pressured to increase prices to satisfy investors seeking returns the platform can remain affordable for smaller contractors while still being profitable longterm thinking bootstrapped companies can optimize for sustainability rather than explosive growth followed by exit this allows quoteiq to build lasting relationships with customers the tradeoffs and how quoteiq compensates vidan and rogers acknowledge that bootstrapping does mean slower overall growth than vcfunded competitors they cant hire as quickly and dont have the massive marketing budgets their competitors deploy however this constraint has forced them to innovate in marketing approach rather than relying on paid advertising and traditional marketing campaigns quoteiq leverages organic marketing and guerrillastyle tactics to compete these strategies draw directly from vidans experience building multiple businesses and training tens of thousands of contractors this organic approach includes content marketing through social media over 2 million combined followers educational resources and training programs that build authority community building within specific trades wordofmouth growth driven by genuinely solving contractor problems aioptimized content strategies website farming that create compound visibility these guerrilla marketing tactics allow quoteiq to compete effectively without matching the advertising spend of venturebacked competitors proving that resourcefulness can substitute for budget size expanding the quoteiq ecosystem with quoteiqs core crm platform established the virtual call team handling customer communication and budgetbuiltsites addressing digital presence vidan and rogers have built an integrated ecosystem that addresses multiple pain points for service businesses operations quoteiq crm manages scheduling estimates invoicing and customer relationships communication virtual call team ensures no opportunities are missed marketing budgetbuiltsites positions businesses for aidriven discovery this comprehensive approach differentiates quoteiq from singlepurpose tools and gives the platform unique value in an increasingly competitive market the road ahead staying independent as quoteiq continues growing and rejecting acquisition offers vidan and rogers remain committed to their founding principles theyve demonstrated that its possible to build significant software businesses without venture capital compete against wellfunded competitors and maintain control over company direction their story challenges the prevailing narrative that home service software inevitably consolidates into a few massive venturebacked platforms by staying focused on contractor needs maintaining profitability and innovating around the edges ai search optimization virtual call teams quoteiq has carved out a sustainable position in a competitive market for other entrepreneurs considering whether to bootstrap or raise capital quoteiqs trajectory offers a compelling case study in the viability of the independent patheven in markets dominated by companies that have raised hundreds of millions in funding the question isnt whether quoteiq can compete with vcbacked giants theyre already doing it the question is whether other entrepreneurs will follow their model and prove that contractorfocused profitablygrown alternatives can thrive alongside the corporate players learn more about quoteiq daily reading article space odyssey 2026 humanitys giant leap back to the moon as january 2026 unfolds the global aerospace community is holding its collective breath for artemis ii the most significant crewed spaceflight mission in over half a century currently sitting on the launchpad at kennedy space center the space launch system sls rocket is undergoing final systemwide testing for a launch window opening as early as february 6 2026 this 10day mission will carry four astronautsreid wiseman victor glover christina koch and jeremy hansenon a highstakes loop around the moon unlike the apollo missions of the past artemis ii is not just a demonstration of power but a rigorous test of the lifesupport and navigation systems required to sustain human life in the deepspace cislunar void while nasa captures the headlines with human explorers 2026 is also the year the moon rush becomes a commercial reality a fleet of private robotic landers is racing to the lunar surface to scout for resources and establish infrastructure jeff bezoss blue origin is set to debut its blue moon mark 1 lander while companies like intuitive machines and firefly aerospace are targeting the lunar south pole and the far side of the moon these missions are critical precursors to permanent habitats searching specifically for water ice in shadowed cratersa resource that could one day be converted into drinking water and rocket fuel for missions to mars beyond the moon the year 2026 marks a shift toward a truly multipolar and diversified space economy india is moving into the final stages of its gaganyaan program aiming to join the elite group of nations capable of independent human spaceflight simultaneously private enterprises are looking upward for more than just exploration startup vast is preparing to launch haven1 which aims to be the worlds first commercial space station this transition from governmentled flags and footprints to a marketdriven orbital economy suggests that space is no longer just a destination for pioneers but a new frontier for industry and permanent residence however the space odyssey of 2026 is not without its challenges the rapid increase in satellite constellations and lunar traffic has sparked urgent global conversations regarding space debris and orbital traffic control as the us and china accelerate their respective plans for lunar bases 2026 will likely be remembered as the year that space diplomacy became as vital as rocket science whether it is through the nasaled artemis accords or new international frameworks the decisions made this year will determine whether the next decade of exploration is defined by collaboration or a new celestial cold war

payana car museum episode 2 the payana car museum is a dedicated vintage and classic automobile museum located on the bengalurumysuru expressway near brahmapura in srirangapatna karnataka established in 2024 it has quickly become one of the most intriguing destinations for automobile enthusiasts history buffs students and travellers exploring karnatakas rich heritage origins and vision the museum was conceived and developed by dr d veerendra heggade a noted philanthropist cultural patron and administrator of the dharmasthala temple trust his deep passion for automobiles and their history inspired the creation of payana a place where the evolution of personal and commercial transport can be experienced firsthand the name payana itself means journey in kannada symbolizing both the physical journey through time and the narrative each vehicle carries architecturally the museum is distinctive its entrance building features a tyreshaped dome which makes it instantly recognizable to travellers on the highway this striking design reflects the museums playful yet earnest celebration of automotive heritage collection highlights spread across an expansive campus with indoor and outdoor exhibit spaces payana houses a large and evergrowing collection of vehicles both fourwheelers and twowheelers spanning many decades of automotive history the exhibits include early century cars luxury classics military vehicles iconic motorcycles and rare vehicles that rarely feature in indian museums some standout pieces include a 1962 standard herald which holds personal significance as the first car owned by dr heggade himself a 1949 daimler de 36 once owned by the maharaja of mysore a studebaker champion that belonged to nobel laureate cv raman an example of how the museums collection interweaves automotive history with broader cultural narratives other treasures like the 1925 fiat 501 1946 dodge power wagon 1947 citroen traction avant and midcentury classics that span continents and automotive design philosophies each vehicle on display is accompanied by detailed information about its model year of manufacture origin and historical context allowing visitors to appreciate not just the mechanics but also the sociocultural impact of these machines visitor experience payana is designed to be more than just a static exhibit the museum features themed zones interactive displays and informative plaques that take visitors on a chronological journey through automotive development some areas even offer augmented reality ar experiences bringing history to life beyond traditional exhibits the venue also includes practical visitor amenities such as wheelchairaccessible ramps ample parking rest areas and a cafeteria ticket prices are very affordable around 5075 making it accessible to families and school groups alike broader impact since opening its doors payana has drawn significant attention attracting visitors from across karnataka and neighboring states it is emerging not only as a tourist highlight on the bengalurumysuru corridor but also as an educational hub where the evolution of technology design and culture is celebrated through automotive history in essence the payana car museum is a tribute to the ingenuity of automotive engineers the stories of their owners and the journey these vehicles have taken through time a place where history is preserved on wheels waiting to be explored

coastal experiences in halifax halifax is known for its coast filled with history and experiences heres a list of ways to enjoy it from digging for clams to exploring historic islands clam digging at clam harbour join a professional guide for an hour of clam digging during low tide you can book this experience through memory lane heritage village where youll learn tips and techniques while spending time working on the tidal flats a tradition that has been part of this region for generations clam harbour beach sandcastle competition august the annual competition is celebrating its 45th anniversary find dozens of creations crafted by 60 to 80 participants many of whom team up to build larger and more elaborate designs coastal camping find two oceanfront camping spots on the eastern shore at norse cove oceanfront camping kayaking and murphys camping on the ocean at norse cove youll get an oceanside tent a camper site or a nordic hut enjoy the ocean campfire rings a sheltered bbq area and access to the longhouse a common space with games and hot drinks murphys offers a mix of tent sites rv sites geodomes and cottage rentals next to the ocean youll have access to kayak rentals boat tours and island dropoffs providing the chance to explore the wild islands coast enjoy the canteen social hall floating dock playground lawn games and crab catching coastal hiking explore one of these oceanside trails mcnabs island hike around the island relax on the beach birdwatch and learn the islands role in halifaxs history at fort mcnab or fort ives take a guided tour with the friends of mcnabs island society such as a heritage nature coastal shoreline or forest bathing tour on the water experiences try standup paddleboarding sea and river kayaking surfing or jet skiing georges island learn about the islands history and its role in the halifax defence complex along with mikmaw history and the nearly 1000 acadians who were captured and detained on the island during the great upheaval of 17551764 take a tour of the tunnels and observe rifled muzzleloading guns caponiers and other aspects of the forts defences even though halifax was never attacked most of what youll see in the tunnels is from 1864 to 1873

my school research project parasocial relationships in kpop fandom introduction parasocial relationshipsonesided emotional bonds that audiences form with media figureshave long been understood as a central feature of mediated celebrity culture early foundational scholarship emphasized how repeated exposure and perceived intimacy allow viewers to feel personally connected to public figures despite no real interaction turner west 2015 contemporary research has expanded this framework to consider how social media livestreaming and constant idol visibility intensify these relationships deepening the illusion of mutuality and emotional closeness mclaren jin 2023 nowhere is this dynamic more evident or more structurally intentional than in the global kpop industry kpop is uniquely engineered to cultivate intense parasocial bonds scholars note that the industry operates on a system of manufactured accessibility where idols are positioned not simply as performers but as emotionally available companions whose lives feel continuously open to fans roh 2024 industry practices such as dating bans strict behavioral control and curated public personas frame idols as perpetually devoted to fans reinforcing the fantasy of exclusivity and emotional reciprocity likewise variety shows behindthescenes content daily livestreaming and official fancommunication platforms such as weverse bubble and paid messaging apps offer fans the illusion of direct dialogue and personal closeness these interactions are not accidental but serve as the economic backbone of the kpop model which relies heavily on emotional investment as a form of consumption fanserviceintentional displays of affection flirtation or intimacy performed for fansfurther reinforces these emotional ties roh 2024 argues that fanservice and idol selfdisclosure function as platformed affective labor where idols cultivate warmth vulnerability and relatability as part of their contractual obligations fans respond by forming emotional bonds that mirror genuine friendship or romantic attachment even when those feelings are explicitly unreciprocated studies on parasocial connections within kpop fandoms reveal that these bonds can significantly impact selfesteem belonging and emotional wellbeing offering comfort during periods of loneliness or instability sayson 2020 these structures position the kpop parasocial system not as a passive outcome but as an intentional design that maximizes fan devotion and by extension profit because the kpop industry is intentionally built around cultivating emotional dependence fans lived experiences provide critical insight into how these structures operate on an individual level existing research demonstrates that parasocial connections can positively shape mental health through feelings of validation belonging and emotional companionship yet they can simultaneously create distress when idol actions industry scandals or life events disrupt the imagined bond mclaren jin 2023 these emotional fluctuations reveal the psychological complexity of parasocial attachmentparticularly among young adults who rely on idols during identity formation or social isolation this research report investigates how kpop fans personally experience parasocial connection how industry practices shape those experiences and how these relationships influence emotional wellbeing through qualitative interviews with fans who follow kpop idols the project explores questions central to current scholarly conversations how do fans describe their emotional attachment to idols how do industry structures shape the depth of these bonds and how do these relationships affect fans mental health daily life and sense of belonging by examining fans lived experiences alongside established research this study aims to illuminate the psychological social and industrial mechanisms that sustain parasocial relationships in kpop ultimately this work contributes to a growing understanding of how entertainment industriesand the intentional design of intimate celebrity accessreshape the emotional lives of young people in the digital era methods research design this study used a qualitative interviewbased research design to explore how kpop fans experience parasocial connections and how these relationships interact with emotional wellbeing qualitative interviewing is an effective method for examining parasocial bonds because it centers the participants own narrative allowing researchers to observe how individuals interpret their emotional attachments in their own words sayson 2020 this approach aligns with contemporary parasocial scholarship which emphasizes the value of subjective accounts when studying emotionally charged fanidol relationships mclaren jin 2023 given the personal and reflective nature of the topic the interviews were conducted via textbased responses allowing participants more time to think through their emotions articulate complex experiences and respond without the pressure of realtime conversation this method also mirrors the way parasocial relationships in kpop often developthrough mediated asynchronous communication that feels intimate despite the lack of physical interaction roh 2024 participants five participants were recruited from the researchers personal social network all of whom identified as fans of bts or another kpop idol or group their names were replaced with pseudonyms fan 1 fan 2 etc to protect confidentiality participants represented a range of fan experiences casual fans longterm fans who had followed idols since debut and fans who had experienced strong parasocial attachment at various points in their lives the researcher also completed the interview themselves as one of the participants this reflexive component aligns with phenomenological approaches in fan studies where researchers often acknowledge their own fan identity as a way to contextualize interpretations and maintain transparency sayson 2020 data collection participants were asked five openended questions designed to examine 1 how and when they became fans of their favorite idol or group 2 how they describe their emotional connection 3 how fandom involvement has shaped their social lives 4 what emotions they associate with their fandom community 5 how the parasocial bond affects their overall wellbeing these questions were adapted directly from literature discussing media attachment emotional resonance and parasocial relationship dynamics for example turner and west 2015 emphasize the importance of examining perceived closeness and emotional intensity while mclaren and jin 2023 highlight the need to evaluate both positive and negative psychological effects additionally the structure of the questions reflects rohs 2024 findings on how kpops institutional practicessuch as idol selfdisclosure variety content and platformed intimacyshape fans sense of connection all responses were collected through text messages interviews ranged from short paragraphs to extended reflective answers depending on the participants comfort and familiarity with the topic data analysis after collecting responses the researcher conducted a thematic coding process identifying recurring emotional and behavioral patterns across participants coding was guided by categories derived from existing parasocial literature emotional intimacy feeling understood or supported by idols identity formation idol influence on selfconcept social connection fandom as community emotional fluctuation mood changes linked to idol behavior or industry events industry influence responses shaped by kpops structural mechanisms coding was iterative and interpretive reflecting the qualitative tradition of grounding themes in lived experience rather than numerical measurement methodological limitations a key limitation of this study is that the researcher personally knew each participant familiarity likely influenced the level of honesty in responses as participants may have minimized more intense or negative emotions to avoid judgment additionally because the sample is small and demographically narrow the findings cannot be generalized across all kpop fans another limitation stems from selfreported data as roh 2024 notes fans often reinterpret their own parasocial attachments in ways that align with community norms or personal identity meaning responses may reflect both genuine feeling and curated selfpresentation despite these limitations the depth and richness of the participants narratives provide valuable insight into how parasocial relationships function within the structural context of the kpop industry findings the purpose of this study was to explore how kpop fans experience parasocial relationships how industry practices shape those connections and how these emotional bonds influence wellbeing and social life analysis of the interview data revealed five major themes 1 pathways into fandom 2 emotional intimacy and perceived support 3 the role of digital spaces and community belonging 4 emotional ambivalence and distress and 5 the influence of kpops structural design on fan attachment these themes demonstrate that parasocial relationships are not accidental byproducts of media exposure but highly structured emotional experiences shaped by intentional industry practices roh 2024 the participants narratives reflect many of the same patterns that parasocial relationship scholarssuch as mclaren and jin 2023 and sayson 2020identify in studies of kpop fandom emotional investment and digital intimacy 1 pathways into fandom attraction vulnerability and timing most participants described entering fandom at a meaningful or unstable time in their lives for some this occurred during adolescence early high school or during the covid19 pandemica period of intense social isolation fan 1 and fan 3 both described discovering bts at low points where they lacked support from friends or peers fan 2 explained that while her initial attraction was superficial i thought the boys were really attractive she soon became invested in their personal narratives artistry and emotional vulnerability this pattern aligns with research showing that fans often form parasocial bonds during periods of identity formation or emotional need sayson 2020 emotional susceptibility paired with the constant visibility of kpop idols creates ideal conditions for developing strong parasocial ties mclaren jin 2023 2 emotional intimacy and parasocial closeness across participants the emotional connection to idols was described as personal intense and sometimes transformative fan 1 stated that bts means more to me than anything else in my life describing depressive episodes linked to the groups military enlistment fan 3 credited bts with teaching them to love myself claiming they would not be the same person without this influence fan 5 described their idol as a role model whose music helps them manage mental health struggles these accounts reflect what parasocial scholars call perceived intimacy where fans feel understood supported or emotionally strengthened by idols despite no reciprocal relationship turner west 2015 roh 2024 argues that this intimacy is engineered by the industry through emotional storytelling idol vulnerability and routine selfdisclosurea pattern directly reflected in participants testimonies the intensity of fan 1s response i have physically cried over this group is consistent with saysons 2020 findings that kpop fans often interpret idols emotional openness as genuine care producing strong affective bonds 3 digital fandom spaces and community belonging participants consistently highlighted the influence of online fandom spaces on social belonging for some like fan 1 and fan 5 digital communities served as a source of connection during isolation fan 1 noted that online fandoms make fans feel closer to the group and the community while fan 5 described making lifelong friendships through fandom interactions even participants who no longer actively participate in fandom spaces acknowledged their past importance fan 3 explained that while their involvement has decreased due to school responsibilities early online fan communities shaped their sense of belonging and provided companionship this reflects broader research mclaren and jin 2023 note that fandom platforms create a social architecture where fans not only bond with idols but also with one another in kpop specifically roh 2024 emphasizes that fan platforms such as weverse or paid messaging services like bubble are designed to cultivate community identity around shared intimacy with idols 4 emotional ambivalence conflict and distress while many participants reported overwhelmingly positive effects the data also revealed emotional tensions fan 2 provided the clearest articulation of ambivalence although she describes her attachment as a special interest she discussed emotional discomfort when idols face scandals or dating rumors it made me question my values it scared me how much it did end up affecting me similarly fan 1 described depressive symptoms triggered by btss military enlistment and mood instability related to idol activity these findings mirror the work of sayson 2020 who argues that parasocial relationships among kpop fans can produce emotional volatility especially when fans experience disruptions to the imagined relationship mclaren and jin 2023 further note that parasocial distress often emerges when idols actions conflict with fans moral frameworks or selfconcepts even participants who framed their connection positively acknowledged the potential for harm fan 3 explained they intentionally maintain a loose connection during stressful periods to prevent emotional overdependence 5 industry structures and the manufacturing of attachment although participants did not always explicitly identify structural mechanisms their experiences reflected many patterns discussed in rohs 2024 research on kpops intentional cultivation of parasocial loyalty kpop idols are expected to maintain emotional openness and availability through frequent livestreaming fanservice interactions curated vulnerability dating bans and behavioral restrictions behindthescenes content paid messaging platforms designed to imitate intimacy these practices create an illusion of reciprocal connection which many participants internalized as genuine emotional closeness for example fan 1 centered much of their identity around bts and adjusted their daily life skipping school rearranging routines to maintain the connection fan 2 described feeling conflicted when an idol violated political or ethical expectations highlighting how deeply fans internalize idols behavior fan 4 who has followed bts since 2013 framed idols positivity and kindness as deeply personal supports despite having no direct interaction these interpretations align with rohs argument that kpop operates on a model of managed authenticity where idols intimacy is heavily scripted yet emotionally persuasive the participants interviews overwhelmingly confirm that industry structures not only shape fan experiences but actively intensify them producing attachments that feel personally meaningful even when they cause emotional conflict discussion the findings from this study reveal that parasocial relationships within kpop fandoms are complex emotional experiences shaped by both personal circumstances and deliberate industry design this discussion interprets those findings through the lens of existing scholarship on parasocial interaction emotional wellbeing fan culture and the kpop industrial system the results align closely with the broader literature demonstrating that kpop fandom is a uniquely structured environment in which emotional connection identity formation and industrydriven intimacy operate simultaneously parasocial intimacy as emotional support one of the most prominent patterns in the findings was the intense emotional closeness fans felt with their idols participants described kpop idols as sources of comfort during periods of loneliness selfdoubt or depression this aligns with saysons 2020 argument that parasocial attachments among kpop fans often emerge from emotional vulnerability with idols serving as perceived anchors of support during difficult developmental stages similarly mclaren and jin 2023 note that modern parasocial relationships are intensified by digital media where idols openly share personal stories struggles and emotions this curated vulnerability deepens fans sense of emotional reciprocity even though the relationship remains onesided the experiences of fan 1 and fan 3 support this view both framed bts as lifechanging influences crediting their idols with significant improvements in selfworth and emotional resilience turner and wests foundational work on parasocial theory also aligns with these findings particularly their claim that repeated exposure and perceived personality intimacy contribute to strong emotional bonds participants descriptions of following livestreams consuming hours of content and emotionally reacting to idol activities directly reflect this process overall the interviews support existing scholarship by showing that parasocial intimacy is not a passive emotional accident it is an active psychological interpretation based on a sense of proximity empathy and trust cultivated over time emotional ambivalence and parasocial risk although many participants emphasized the positive aspects of their parasocial connections several also described emotional conflict or distress fan 1 experienced mood disturbances based on btss military enlistment while fan 2 expressed anxiety and moral conflict over idol controversies this ambivalence reflects findings in mclaren and jin 2023 who argue that parasocial attachments have the capacity to create both comfort and affective instability when idols behave in ways that challenge fans moral frameworks or disrupt expectations the parasocial illusion is threatened often producing emotional discomfort sayson 2020 similarly notes that fans may experience distress when the imagined relationship does not align with realitywhether because of dating news scandals or changes in idol behavior fan 2s narrative closely mirrors this phenomenon her feelings of guilt uncertainty and dissonance emerged precisely because the parasocial bond felt meaningful enough to impact her value system these findings therefore support the argument that parasocial relationships function as emotionally highstakes attachments for some fans even when they recognize the onesided nature of the relationship fandom community and digital belonging participants descriptions of fandom as a social space also reinforce existing scholarship on the role of community in digital fan cultures according to sayson 2020 kpop fandoms often act as emotional ecosystems where fans share experiences validate one anothers feelings and coconstruct meaning around idol behaviors participants like fan 1 and fan 5 emphasized how online fandom shaped their social lives introducing them to new communities and friendships even participants who no longer actively engage such as fan 3 acknowledged that fandom spaces played an important role in their earlier development mclaren and jin 2023 argue that parasocial attachment often works in tandem with community belonging creating a dual emotional framework one centered on the idol and one centered on fellow fans the interview data support this model showing that fans often interpret their emotional connection through shared community experiencesconcert lines group chats online discourse and collective reactions thus this study extends existing research by demonstrating that digital belonging remains influential even when parasocial attachment fluctuates over time industry design and the manufacturing of parasocial attachment perhaps the most significant contribution of this study is the evidence showing how fans parasocial experiences reflect intentional structural mechanisms built into the kpop industry roh 2024 argues that kpops business model is explicitly engineered to maximize parasocial intensity through dating bans and behavioral restrictions that imply idols are emotionally available fanservice that mimics romantic or affectionate interactions constant vulnerability disclosure in variety shows livestreams and documentaries paid platforms weverse dm bubble fromm designed to imitate private conversation platformed accessibility where idols appear relatable ordinary and emotionally open participants showed clear effects of these structural mechanisms even when they did not name them directly for example fan 1 centered much of their identity and routine around bts demonstrating the managed authenticity roh 2024 describeswhere idol openness persuades fans that emotional investment is mutual fan 2s distress over idol controversies echoes rohs point that kpop idols moral positioning is strategically crafted causing fans to internalize their behavior deeply fan 4s decadelong loyalty reflects the longterm attachment that the industrys continuous visibility model produces these findings suggest that parasocial relationships in kpop fandom cannot be understood solely as psychological phenomena they are also culturally and structurally produced by an industry that profits from emotional intensity this represents a significant alignment with rohs 2024 argument that kpop idols perform affective labora form of emotional work designed to generate revenue by deepening fans sense of closeness significance of the results together the findings highlight that 1 parasocial relationships in kpop are emotionally meaningful and often beneficial 2 these connections can produce emotional volatility especially during disruptions 3 online fandom functions as a powerful site of social belonging and identity formation 4 the kpop industry actively engineers conditions that intensify parasocial attachment influencing the emotional experiences fans report this synthesis reinforces the idea that parasocial relationships are not merely personal attachments but structural outcomes shaped by a multimedia entertainment system designed to capitalize on emotional investment by focusing on fans lived experiences this study expands the scholarly conversation by revealing how deeply industrycontrolled intimacy shapes daytoday emotional life the findings suggest that future research should examine how specific kpop industry practicessuch as dating bans curated vulnerability and paid messaging platformsimpact fan wellbeing differently across varying levels of engagement conclusion the results of this study demonstrate that parasocial relationships within kpop fandoms are neither accidental nor purely psychologicalthey are deeply emotional experiences shaped by individual needs and intentionally reinforced by the structural design of the kpop industry through qualitative interviews fans described their idols as sources of comfort identity motivation and belonging these attachments frequently emerged during periods of vulnerability confirming prior research showing that parasocial bonds develop when individuals seek stability connection or emotional support sayson 2020 mclaren jin 2023 at the same time the findings reveal that these relationships can introduce emotional ambivalence and distress participants reported mood fluctuations tied to idol activities anxiety during controversies and occasional conflict between their values and their parasocial attachments these patterns reinforce scholarship demonstrating that parasocial relationships can simultaneously offer emotional safety and create emotional disruption when expectations or illusions of intimacy are challenged turner west 2015 mclaren jin 2023 however what distinguishes kpop from other parasocial contextsand what makes these emotional dynamics particularly powerfulis the industrys intentional cultivation of intimacy drawing from rohs 2024 analysis this study highlights how idols emotional availability fanservice interactions dating bans livestreamed vulnerability and paid messaging systems create an ecosystem where emotional closeness feels reciprocal even though it is onesided participants experiences reflect this structure directly their feelings of personal connection responsibility and identity formation mirror the very mechanisms the kpop system is built upon these insights carry significant implications they illustrate that kpop fandom is not merely a leisure activity but an emotionally embedded space where fans negotiate identity belonging and inner conflict more importantly they show that parasocial relationships in kpop cannot be understood without acknowledging the industrial logic that profits from emotional dependence this dual perspectivepsychological and structuralprovides a more complete understanding of why these relationships feel so impactful and why they can influence fans wellbeing so deeply while this study is limited by its small conveniencebased sample and the researchers familiarity with participants the findings offer valuable groundwork for future research larger anonymous studies of engagement future research may also explore how fans themselves develop strategies for balancing emotional attachment with critical awareness of the industrys constructed intimacy ultimately this how to travel solo wildlife adventure in india solo wildlife travel in india feels a bit like stepping into your own movie you land in a new place with just your backpack your camera and your curiosity and the rest of the story slowly unfolds in front of you a tiger crossing the track in silence an elephant herd walking through golden light a forest guide whispering stories by the campfire at night it is just you and the wild no distractions no compromises no fixed script for many people solo travel already feels like a big step solo wildlife adventure in india can sound even bigger maybe even a little scary forests unknown places new languages wild animals safety doubts and the fear of feeling alone but with the right planning mindset and guidance solo wildlife trips in india can become the most powerful healing and unforgettable journeys of your life this guide will walk you through everything you need to know to plan a safe meaningful and exciting solo wildlife adventure in india from choosing the right national parks and staying safe to meeting like minded travelers and finding moments of silence that change you from within you will find it all here in a simple friendly way why choose a solo wildlife adventure in india traveling solo for wildlife is very different from a regular holiday you are not just checking places off a list you are entering living landscapes watching real life unfold in front of your eyes india is one of the best countries in the world for this kind of journey india offers incredible wildlife diversity you can look for tigers in madhya pradesh and rajasthan rhinos in assam lions in gujarat elephants in kerala leopards in jawai and jhalana and rare birds almost everywhere the forests are old the ecosystems are alive and each national park has its own personality a solo wildlife trip gives you freedom to choose your pace dates and budget time to sit quietly and really absorb what you see space for reflection journaling and photography without rushing more chances to connect deeply with local guides naturalists and fellow travelers when you are alone you notice more the sound of dry leaves under the jeep the nervous calls of langurs when a predator is near the way light falls on river water at sunrise these details stay with you long after the trip ends is solo wildlife travel in india safe this is usually the first question that comes to mind and it is a fair one the short answer is yes solo wildlife travel in india can be safe if you plan well choose trusted operators and use basic common sense inside national parks safaris are strictly regulated you are never allowed to walk inside core zones on your own you always go with a registered guide and driver in a jeep canter or boat camps and lodges near forests have safety measures trained staff and clear rules for guests as a solo traveler especially if you are a woman it helps to book stays with good reviews and clear ratings use registered safari operators instead of last minute touts share your basic itinerary with a family member or friend avoid walking alone in dark isolated areas around villages at night trust your instincts and say no when something feels off most wildlife areas in india are used to receiving international and solo travelers people are usually helpful curious and hospitable with a bit of awareness and respect for local culture you are likely to feel safe and welcome choosing the right wildlife destination for your first solo trip india has many national parks and wildlife sanctuaries so it can feel overwhelming to pick just one the key is to choose based on your comfort level what you want to see and how experienced you are as a solo traveler great options for first time solo wildlife travelers these parks are popular well connected and have plenty of stay options ranthambore national park rajasthan ideal if you are starting from jaipur or delhi it is famous for tigers beautiful landscapes and easy accessibility jim corbett national park uttarakhand perfect if you like greenery rivers and a calm atmosphere you may see elephants deer birds and if you are lucky a tiger kanha and bandhavgarh national parks madhya pradesh both are excellent for tiger sightings kanha has dreamy sal forests and meadows bandhavgarh is intense and thrilling pench national park mpmaharashtra peaceful scenic and less crowded great for those who enjoy slow travel and nature kaziranga national park assam best for one horned rhinos elephants and lovely grassland landscapes gir national park gujarat the only place to see asiatic lions in the wild if you are a beginner avoid very remote areas for your first solo wildlife trip start with a well known park get a feel for the rhythm and then you can explore more offbeat places like tadoba jawai or the sundarbans later how to plan your solo wildlife itinerary planning a solo wildlife adventure in india is all about balancing travel time safari time and rest instead of rushing through many parks focus on one or two and spend a few days in each a simple structure could be day 1 travel to the nearest town reach your lodge rest and enjoy the surroundings day 2 morning and afternoon safari relax in between talk to guides stargaze at night day 3 another safari village walk birdwatching or nature trail depending on the park day 4 last safari and departure if you are doing multiple parks you can link them smartly for example you can combine kanha and bandhavgarh or ranthambore with bharatpur keoladeo bird sanctuary think about how many days you truly have how far the park is from the nearest airport or railway station the best season for the park you want to visit how many safaris you want to experience at least three to four is ideal you do not need a very complicated schedule what you need is enough time in the forest to increase your chances of sightings and to really sink into the feel of the place booking safaris and stays without stress as a solo traveler you want things to be smooth so that you can focus on the experience not the logistics where to book safaris most popular national parks in india allow online safari bookings through forest department websites or trusted travel partners there are usually two main vehicle types jeep safari smaller more flexible more personal good for photography and intimate experiences canter safari bigger open bus like vehicles slightly less flexible but more economical and a good way to share the experience with others book safaris at least a few weeks in advance for popular parks and peak seasons especially if you want specific zones in tiger parks choosing the right stay as a solo wildlife traveler the place you stay can shape your entire experience look for lodges close to the park gate to reduce travel time before safaris properties known for experienced naturalists and guided nature walks reviews that mention safety cleanliness and good hospitality stays that offer shared safari bookings so you do not have to book a full jeep alone if that feels expensive some eco lodges also host evening talks about animal behavior conservation or photography which can be great for solo travelers who enjoy learning and meeting others what to pack for a solo wildlife adventure in india packing right makes your solo journey easier more comfortable and more enjoyable the goal is to travel light but smart here are essentials to consider light breathable clothes in earthy shades like olive brown beige or khaki a warm layer if you are traveling in winter because morning safaris can be cold a good pair of closed shoes or trekking shoes hat or cap sunglasses and sunscreen to protect from the sun a reusable water bottle and light snacks like nuts or energy bars binoculars for birdwatching and spotting wildlife at a distance a camera with zoom if you enjoy photography plus extra batteries and memory cards a small backpack or sling bag for carrying things during safaris basic medicines including something for motion sickness if you need it a power bank for your phone especially if you are staying in remote places you do not need fancy gear to enjoy wildlife even with simple clothes and a curious mind you can have a life changing experience how a solo safari day usually feels every park is different but most days follow a similar rhythm that feels surprisingly peaceful you wake up before sunrise often around 5 am the air is cool sometimes misty sometimes crisp it is quiet in a way cities never are you have some tea or coffee maybe a light snack then head to the gate several jeeps line up guides chat softly and birds slowly begin their morning songs once inside the park the forest opens up tall trees open meadows rocky hills rivers or lakes depending on where you are you watch the sun slowly rise turning everything golden your guide looks for signs fresh pugmarks of tigers hoof marks of deer broken branches alarm calls of langurs or barking deer sometimes everything is calm and you just enjoy the forest waking up sometimes a sudden series of calls sends a rush of excitement through the jeep you might wait at a bend in the road for twenty thirty forty minutes then if you are lucky the jungle reveals itself a tiger walks out confident and quiet or a leopard crosses a distant slope or an elephant herd appears near a river even if you do not see a big cat you might spend time with a family of langurs a pair of jackals or a group of wild boar after a few hours you return to the lodge for breakfast and rest the day continues with reading walking around the property chatting with staff or simply lying on a hammock listening to birds in the afternoon you go for another safari at night you may sit by a bonfire share stories with other travelers and watch the stars solo this rhythm becomes even more powerful because you are not distracted you are fully present meeting people as a solo wildlife traveler traveling alone does not mean being lonely in fact national parks are some of the easiest places to meet like minded people you share jeeps or canters with other travelers you sit together for meals at the lodge you listen to the same guide telling you about how tigers mark their territory or how birds migrate thousands of kilometers these shared moments naturally lead to conversation you may meet other solo travelers both indian and international wildlife photographers who have visited many parks families who love nature and are curious to learn local guides with decades of stories about individual tigers leopards and elephants you do not have to be very social if you do not want to but if you feel like talking asking questions or sharing experiences you will find many chances some solo travelers end up planning their next safari together with new friends they meet on the previous one solo safety tips inside and outside the jungle inside the jungle your main responsibility is to follow the rules these are not just for your safety but for the safety of animals and the health of the ecosystem important rules include never get down from the safari vehicle inside the park unless the guide clearly allows it at designated points do not shout play loud music or make sudden movements to disturb animals never throw food or try to feed wildlife do not ask guides to get too close to animals or violate distance norms for a better photo respect the forest timings and gate rules outside the park in nearby towns or villages basic solo travel safety applies avoid walking alone in very dark isolated areas late at night keep your valuables secure and do not leave them unattended use registered cabs or transport services whenever possible be polite but firm if you are not interested in certain offers or services when in doubt you can always ask your lodge to arrange safe and trusted transport guides or activities budgeting for a solo wildlife trip in india wildlife travel can be done in both a budget friendly and a luxury way depending on your choices as a solo traveler you may need to plan a bit more carefully because you are not splitting costs your main expenses will be transport flights trains or cars to reach the park accommodation ranges from simple homestays to luxury lodges safari permits and vehicle costs food and tips to keep costs balanced you can travel in shoulder seasons like november or february when prices are not at the highest choose mid range lodges that offer clean rooms and good food without being too fancy share jeeps or canters with other travelers instead of booking a private vehicle every time combine train travel with short taxi rides instead of long private car transfers it is possible to have a fulfilling solo wildlife adventure in india without spending a fortune especially if you are flexible with dates and ready to stay in simple but comfortable places emotional benefits of solo wildlife travel beyond the animals beyond the photos something deeper happens on a solo wildlife journey nature has a way of softening the edges of stress the more time you spend watching trees rivers and animals the more you feel your own breathing slow down you start to notice small things again sunlight on leaves patterns on butterfly wings the smell of wet earth many solo travelers say they gained confidence after navigating trains jeeps and new places by themselves they discovered they enjoy their own company more than they thought they felt inspired peaceful or even healed after days in the forest they left with more respect and love for animals and the environment a solo wildlife adventure in india is not just travel it often becomes a turning point a quiet inner reset simple mistakes to avoid to keep your trip smooth try to avoid common mistakes like booking everything at the last minute in peak season which can lead to high prices or no safari availability trying to cover too many parks in too few days which makes the trip tiring and rushed ignoring local advice about weather road conditions or safety having very rigid expectations like i must see a tiger or this trip is a failure wildlife is not a zoo you might see tigers on your first safari or not even after several what you will definitely see is a living forest full of stories and interactions the more open you are the more you receive how to choose responsible operators and lodges because you love wildlife it is important to support people and places that care about conservation when choosing where to book look for lodges that avoid loud parties plastic waste and unnecessary disturbance guides who respect animals maintain distance and follow park rules operators who hire local staff and share benefits with nearby communities properties that save water reduce power use and avoid cutting trees unnecessarily by choosing responsible tourism you become part of the solution your solo trip then supports forests and local families not just your own adventure

the fix earth before going to mars argument is the peak of human shortsightedness and historical ignorance every time we talk about space exploration someone inevitably says why are we spending billions on mars when we have poverty and hunger on earth this is what i call the pothole mentality if we applied this logic throughout history we would have never crossed the oceans because we havent fixed the roads in our village yet we would have never developed flight because we havent perfected the steam engine yet the truth is 1 space tech fixes earth nasas research literally gave us water purification gps advanced medical imaging and solar panels 2 economic impact we arent sending money to mars we are paying engineers scientists and technicians right here on earth 3 insurance policy humanity is far too grand to keep all its eggs in one basket stagnation is the death of civilization if you want to stop exploring until every single problem on earth is solved you are essentially asking for human progress to end

a review of an exciting 2025 2025 has been a year of focused scientific progress and continued advancement of genflow biosciences mission to extend healthy lifespan through our novel longevity gene therapy platform across our portfolio we have maintained momentum in both animal health where progress in our canine study may provide translational insights relevant to future human applications as well as therapeutic development for dogs these advancements have been supported by a strengthened network of leading academic collaborators and laboratories together with continued backing from international institutional investors and previously awarded government grants this ecosystem helped accelerate genflows scientific and clinical development throughout 2025 program highlights weve made a number of notable strides across our programs this year including dog aging gf1004 we made significant strides in our clinical trial for aging dogs with full administration of our investigational sirt6based gene therapy now completed no adverse events were reported during the dosing phase of the study with no serious moderate or minor side effects observed the study which began in march 2025 is being conducted as a blinded clinical trial an initial efficacy readout is expected in q1 2026 including blood analyses and muscle biopsies to evaluate potential benefits related to sarcopenia healthspan and lifespanassociated biomarkers dogs enrolled in the trial will be monitored for 180 days with a second efficacy assessment planned at the sixmonth timepoint and results expected in junejuly 2026 to evaluate durability and longerterm effects mash gf1002 our mash program saw good progress in 2025 while glp1 therapies have addressed earlystage mash patients with advanced fibrosis roughly onethird of the population still face limited treatment options in response we repositioned gf1002 to target this highneed group leveraging its antifibrotic properties and potential to prevent progression to cirrhosis and liver cancer additionally we have generated new preclinical poc data on the prevention of hcc these results further strengthen our strategic focus on patients with advanced mash for whom liver transplantation currently remains the only therapeutic option we are now finalizing our ind package and evaluating mrnalnp delivery as an alternative to aav an approach that could enable repeat dosing and lower manufacturing costs encouraging data continue to support this next phase of research and development glaucoma in 2025 we expanded into ophthalmology where sirt6based gene therapy shows promise in glaucoma a leading cause of irreversible blindness current treatments primarily manage intraocular pressure but do little to prevent optic nerve degeneration preclinical data suggest sirt6 overexpression may protect retinal ganglion cells and preserve optic nerve function shifting the focus from symptom control to true neuroprotection we are advancing discussions with a leading lnp partner to support delivery innovation in this space and are securing a fullservice cro to manage formulation through preclinical execution with the global glaucoma market approaching usd 1214 billion by the early 2030s this represents a compelling longterm opportunity for us additional programs we continued to advance our broader pipeline and are pleased with the steady advancement of the sarcopenia program fully consistent with our development plans in parallel the exofasttrack initiative continues to move forward generating important data will emphasize rationalization of our pipeline prioritizing programs with the strongest data clearest paths to value creation and highest partner interest central to this strategy will be the pursuit of earlystage licensing and collaboration agreements designed to generate nondilutive funding validate our platform externally and support continued development without undue capital strain with a practical limitation of rag in multiagent architectures in a singleagent setup rag usually works reasonably well the assumption is straightforward the same model handles embedding retrieval and usage all within a shared semantic space however once a multiagent setup is introduced problems start to appear in multiagent systems different agents often have different roles use different prompts or even rely on different models in practice this usually means their embedding behaviors are not the same when embedding spaces are no longer aligned a shared ragbased memory becomes difficult to use reliably information that is relevant to one agent may not be retrieved by another simply because their embeddings do not match at this point memory is no longer truly shared it becomes tightly coupled to each agents retrieval setup the system still holds the data but each agent sees a different version of it filtered through its own embedding space over time this divergence makes coordination more difficult rather than easier for this reason it is worth questioning whether retrieval alone should define how agents access memory in multiagent settings memory often needs to exist at a layer above embeddings as a more stable and shared state rather than being reconstructed differently by each agent on every query you are welcome to check out our opensource project memu we have been exploring ways to address the limitations of rag by making memory less dependent on any single agents embeddings in multiagent systems memu uses a threelayer architecture and stores memory in a filebased format because of this design it also supports llmbased nonembedding retrieval im curious how others are handling this issue when building multiagent systems if you do not yet have a good solution you may find memu worth trying

a woman for all men 1975 watch uncut a woman for all men 1975 directed by arthur marks is a lean slice of mid70s american domestic noirwhere wealth desire and suspicion ferment into quiet menace set within a privileged household the film explores how power imbalances and emotional dependency corrode trust from the inside out the story centers on walter mccoy an abrasive controlling millionaire who shocks his family by marrying karen petrie a much younger woman whose charm masks an air of calculation as karen settles into the household fault lines immediately appear walters son steve becomes emotionally entangled with his new stepmother while walters daughter cynthia and the everwatchful housekeeper sarah sense that karens arrival signals trouble rather than stability what follows is a tightening spiral of secrecy and manipulation conversations are loaded loyalties shift and seemingly minor indiscretions ripple into larger consequences the homemeant to be a fortress of privilegeturns into a pressure cooker where every relationship is compromised by desire greed or resentment marks keeps the tension intimate favoring psychological unease over spectacle as motives blur and moral certainty erodes from an archival standpoint the film fits squarely within the eras fascination with respectable spaces hiding corrosive truths it echoes the periods madeforadult thrillers and theatrical crime melodramas using restrained pacing and character friction to build dread today a woman for all men endures as a compact unsettling portrait of domestic power gameswhere control is currency and intimacy becomes a weapon

testing grounds is coming and it raises questions about scope its good to see testing grounds being used to explore player agency starting with armor and speed feels like a sensible first step and its nice that these systemic changes are being tested in a more accessible environment that said it also raises a broader question how far should testing grounds eventually go if it remains limited to changes like armor and speed its longterm value may end up being fairly narrow ideally the mode would support more separate clearlyscoped experiments not all at once for example this could include loosening operatorspecific restrictions on attachments or gadgets testing broader changes to weapon handling such as faster ads or reduced recoil or even revisiting longstanding assumptions like oneshot headshots to observe how different rule sets affect pacing engagements and decisionmaking ultimately expanding player choice and room for expression feels like the natural longterm value of a mode like testing grounds without that it risks becoming a place for occasional parameter tweaks rather than a space for meaningful experimentation what kinds of experiments would you want to see testing grounds try next for context i removed an earlier version due to unclear wording thats on me image reposted from x kudosonyt
